recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast studio portrait of a woman with voluminous dark hair sitting on a black bench against a vibrant pink-to-purple gradient background. She is styled in an eclectic mix of textures including striped leggings, knit leg warmers, and layered fabrics, surrounded by vintage luggage and scattered shoes on a reflective floor.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject's dynamic pose against the horizontal lines of the bench
High-saturation pink background contrasting with the dark bench and subject's hair
Textural interplay between knit wool, smooth spandex, and leather luggage
Reflective floor mirroring the subject and props to ground the composition

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centrally located, occupying the middle and left thirds of the frame, scaled to full-body seated height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The black horizontal slats of the bench provide a structural anchor for the chaotic textures.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the subject's face, follows the arm up, moves down the leg to the luggage, and finally to the typography in the upper right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant negative space in the upper right and lower left, filled with the pink gradient and floor reflections.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation throughout with deep blacks and bright highlights creating a punchy, commercial look.

letterConstructionRules: Top line: Elegant, fluid cursive with exaggerated loops on 'D' and 'S'
Bottom line: Dynamic, slanted brush-style script with sharp terminals
Variable stroke weight mimicking hand-drawn ink
characterSpecificRedesigns: Extended horizontal swashes on capital letters
Interconnected lowercase letters with high-speed slant
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between a formal, looped cursive and a fast, aggressive brush script.
graphicDevices: Horizontal alignment to the right margin

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the fast, energetic feel of the secondary text
Captures the elegant loops of the primary text

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a studio photograph of a woman with big curly hair in 80s eclectic fashion, sitting on a black slatted bench. Background is a vibrant pink gradient. Reflective floor with vintage suitcases and shoes. High contrast lighting.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two lines of right-aligned script text in the upper right. Top line in a black elegant cursive, bottom line in a white energetic brush script.

verificationChecks: Text is right-aligned in the upper quadrant
Background is a smooth magenta gradient
Floor shows clear reflections of the props
Subject's hair is voluminous and dark

mustRedesign: Specific artist name and title text
Any brand logos on the luggage
postGenerationChecks: Is the lighting consistent across subject and props?
Does the typography feel integrated into the 80s aesthetic?
Is the pink gradient smooth without banding?
Are the textures (knit, spandex, wood) distinct?
recipe.reuseFormula: Studio Portrait + 80s Maximalism + Pink Gradient + Stacked Script Typography
